_note: "Tax at normal rates on 15 of Part B-TI": X of FA 2026 s.2(2)(b). tax.bybasis keeps the slab tax as charged (X − Y, W-258), so 2a is 2d − 2b + 2c — the tax on total income less the tax at special rates, plus the rebate on agricultural income; without agricultural income in the rates it is the slab tax, as before (W-258a C1a). Placed by ITR-2 only. Drafted by Claude, adopted by the owner's ruling W-258a (D-779).
